description: Number parse + locale format — Parse n= in almost any human or locale form (1.234.567,89 / 1 234,56 / 12,34,567 lakh grouping / (1,200.50) accounting negatives / $12.5k / 3.2 million / 2 crore / 15% / 0xFF 0b1010 0o17 / Roman numerals / 1.5e6 / leading or trailing currency symbol or ISO code), flagging ambiguous separators (from_locale= forces a reading), then format it for locale= (default en-US): standard, plain, fixed (decimals=, also banker's half-even), compact short/long, scientific, engineering, significant digits (sig=), percent, currency (currency= or detected: symbol, accounting, code, name, compact, minor digits), integer facts (binary/octal/hex/base36, two's complement, Roman, English ordinal), SI and IEC byte sizes, and side-by-side formatting for locales= (up to 12; default 8 common locales). Exact for integers beyond 2^53. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_number_format
